classes.name: Sound
classes.doc: A sound clip that plays everywhere, or from its parent's position when the parent is a part or an attachment.

properties.name: SoundId
properties.doc: The clip's asset id. It resolves through the [compat.assets] table of real.toml; an id that is not there is silent and warns once with RE9350.

properties.name: Volume
properties.doc: Loudness, 0 to 10 (values outside are clamped when played); 1 plays the clip as recorded.

properties.name: PlaybackSpeed
properties.doc: Speed and pitch multiplier; 2 plays twice as fast and an octave higher.

properties.name: Looped
properties.doc: When true, the sound starts over at its end (firing DidLoop) instead of ending.

properties.name: Playing
properties.doc: True while the sound plays. Setting it to true starts the sound from its TimePosition; setting it to false stops it where it is.

properties.name: TimePosition
properties.doc: Seconds into the clip. Setting it seeks; Play starts from the last value a script set.

properties.name: TimeLength
properties.doc: The clip's length in seconds once it has been played, 0 for an unknown id.

properties.name: IsPaused
properties.doc: True when the sound is stopped part-way (by Pause, or Playing set to false).

properties.name: IsLoaded
properties.doc: True once the sound has been played with an id that resolves to a clip.

properties.name: RollOffMode
properties.doc: How a 3D sound fades with distance from the listener: Inverse (min/distance), Linear, LinearSquare or InverseTapered (the smaller of Inverse and LinearSquare). All are silent beyond RollOffMaxDistance.

properties.name: RollOffMinDistance
properties.doc: Studs within which a 3D sound plays at full volume.

properties.name: RollOffMaxDistance
properties.doc: Studs beyond which a 3D sound is silent.

properties.name: PlayOnRemove
properties.note: Stored only: removing the sound does not play it.
properties.doc: When true, the sound plays once as it is removed.

properties.name: PlaybackLoudness
properties.note: Always 0: the layer does not meter the mix.

methods.name: Play
methods.doc: Starts the sound from the last TimePosition a script set (0 by default), firing Played.

methods.name: Stop
methods.doc: Stops the sound and rewinds it to 0, firing Stopped.

methods.name: Pause
methods.doc: Stops the sound where it is, firing Paused; Resume continues from there.

methods.name: Resume
methods.doc: Continues a paused sound, firing Resumed.

events.name: Paused
events.doc: Fires when the sound is paused.

events.name: Resumed
events.doc: Fires when a paused sound continues.

events.name: Stopped
events.doc: Fires when a script stops the sound.

events.name: Ended
events.doc: Fires when a sound that is not looped reaches its end.

events.name: DidLoop
events.doc: Fires each time a looped sound starts over, with the number of times it has.
